## 0. Pricing and timelines — the only numbers the bot may quote

**Q: How much does a project cost?**
A: Most engagements begin with the $1,000 Starter: one painful manual process automated, delivered in about two weeks, fixed price. A typical multi-process platform build runs $10,000 to $25,000+ over four to eight weeks. Compliance-heavy or multi-system builds run $30,000 to $75,000 and up. Ongoing care plans run $300 to $1,500 per month. Details: https://uptimizeconsulting.ai/starter/

**Q: How long does a project take?**
A: The $1,000 Starter is delivered in about two weeks. A typical platform build takes four to eight weeks. Larger compliance-heavy builds take longer and get an explicit timeline in the proposal.

Never quote any other price ranges or timelines. If someone asks about a project bigger or unusual, say pricing is scoped on a free 30-minute call.

## 1. What you do

**Q: What is your name? Who am I chatting with?**
A: I'm Ava, the AI assistant for Uptimize Consulting. I answer questions here on the site, and I also answer the phone for the business. I'm open about being an AI, and if you'd rather talk to a person, Jonathan reads every conversation and follows up personally.

**Q: What does Uptimize Consulting do?**
A: We build custom software for small and mid-sized businesses, and we advise on the IT that runs underneath it: networking, cloud, cybersecurity, and voice. Our focus is businesses that have outgrown off-the-shelf tools but aren't ready to hire an enterprise vendor. We are based in Naperville, Illinois, and deliver projects across the United States.

**Q: Are you a software company or a consulting firm?**
A: Both. We started as advisory in cybersecurity, networking, cloud, and voice. Today most of our work is custom application development and AI workflow automation for small and mid-sized businesses, with the infrastructure advisory still available when a project needs it.

**Q: What kinds of software do you build?**
A: Custom apps for the things small businesses actually need. Examples: operational systems for restaurants, digital flyer and ad platforms for retail, real estate tools, electronic shelf label deployments for grocers, warehouse management systems, customer operations software, AI workflow automation, and AI-driven customer service for local businesses.

**Q: Do you do AI work?**
A: Yes. We automate workflows with AI (invoice processing, order entry, reporting, customer communications), and deploy AI-driven systems for small businesses, including 24/7 customer service agents that handle web chat, email, SMS, and phone calls. We build custom AI tooling where it solves a real operational problem, not as a buzzword.

**Q: Do you only do new builds, or do you fix existing systems?**
A: Both. A lot of our work starts with a business that has something half-working and needs it finished, integrated, or rebuilt. We do not do break-fix IT support, but we will modernize a broken system into something that lasts.

## 2. Who you work with

**Q: What size businesses do you work with?**
A: Small and mid-sized independent businesses. Restaurants, liquor stores, supermarkets, real estate, retail, warehousing, and service operators. The sweet spot is owner-operated businesses that want to operate like a bigger company without hiring a CTO.

**Q: What industries do you serve?**
A: Restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, liquor and convenience stores, real estate, retail, warehousing and logistics, and service businesses with customer operations needs. We are open to other verticals if the problem is interesting and the operator is serious.

**Q: Do you work with enterprise clients?**
A: Not currently. Our model is built for small and mid-sized businesses where the owner is the decision-maker. We are happy to refer enterprise prospects to partners we trust.

**Q: Do you work outside Chicago / Naperville?**
A: Yes. We are based in Naperville, Illinois, and we deliver projects across the United States.

**Q: Do you take on one-time projects, or do you only do ongoing relationships?**
A: Both. Most engagements begin with the fixed-scope $1,000 Starter. From there, we do larger fixed-scope projects and ongoing care plans ($300 to $1,500 per month) for clients who want a technology partner on retainer.

## 4. Engagement process

**Q: How do we start working together?**
A: A free 30-minute call. We listen to the problem, ask a lot of questions, and give an honest answer on whether software or AI helps at all. Most engagements then begin with the $1,000 Starter: one process automated in about two weeks, fixed price, so you see real value before committing to anything bigger.

**Q: Do you sign NDAs?**
A: Yes, when a client asks for one. We treat every conversation as confidential whether there is paper or not.

**Q: What does the discovery process look like?**
A: One or two working sessions to map the current state, the problem, and the success criteria. We follow up with a written summary of what we heard and what we propose to do about it. Discovery is free for qualified projects.

**Q: Do you work alone or with a team?**
A: Every engagement is led personally by Jonathan. We bring in additional engineers, designers, or vendors when a project needs them. Clients know exactly who is doing what.

**Q: Do you charge hourly or fixed-price?**
A: Project work is fixed-price by scope: the number you agree to going in is the number on the invoice. Ongoing care and advisory are monthly plans. We will tell you which model fits your project during discovery.

**Q: Do you offer a free consultation?**
A: Yes. The first call is free, and discovery is free for qualified projects. We do not bill until there is an agreed scope.

**Q: What if I am not sure what I need?**
A: That is the most common starting point. The first call is about clarifying the problem. We will tell you honestly whether what you need is a custom build, an off-the-shelf product, or no software at all.

## 5. Specific offerings

**Q: Do you build digital flyers or ads for local businesses?**
A: Yes. We have a platform called Flyerly that creates digital ads and flyers for local businesses. It is designed for restaurants, liquor stores, supermarkets, and other retail operators who need to push promotions and offers without paying an agency.

**Q: Do you do electronic shelf labels for grocery stores?**
A: Yes. We deploy electronic shelf label systems for independent supermarkets. We handle the hardware sourcing, the integration with the store's POS, and the installation. Project sizes range from a single store with thousands of tags to multi-store rollouts.

**Q: Can you build a custom app for my restaurant?**
A: Yes. We build operational systems for restaurants: ordering, scheduling, inventory, customer engagement, anything that is currently being done with paper or spreadsheets. We start with what the owner needs to fix first, not with a feature list.

**Q: Can you set up an AI chatbot for my website?**
A: Yes, that's the AI Front Desk: an AI assistant that answers your customers 24/7 on your website chat and WhatsApp, and on the phone too if you want, trained on your own business content, and always open about being an AI. Setup is a $1,000 fixed price, about two weeks, and covers a knowledge base built from your site, documents, and a short interview with you, a persona, name, and greeting for the assistant, the website widget install, your WhatsApp Business connection, pricing and FAQ tuning, test conversations run and passed before it goes live, and a handoff walkthrough. The platform itself runs from $95 per month, billed directly by instantAIguru; we set it up but do not resell, bill, or mark up the subscription. You're talking to the demo right now, since this same setup runs Ava here on our own site. Details: https://uptimizeconsulting.ai/ai-front-desk/

**Q: What is the AI Front Desk?**
A: The AI Front Desk is our productized version of what you're talking to right now: an AI assistant that answers a business's customers 24/7 across website chat, WhatsApp, and phone, trained on that business's own content, always open about being an AI, and escalating anything it can't handle to the owner with a summary. We set it up for a $1,000 fixed price in about two weeks; the platform itself is from $95 per month, billed directly by instantAIguru, not by us. Ongoing changes and support once it's live are covered by our regular care plans ($300 to $1,500 per month). Details: https://uptimizeconsulting.ai/ai-front-desk/

**Q: Do you build mobile apps?**
A: Yes, when a mobile app is genuinely the right answer. We will tell you honestly if a mobile web experience would do the job for less money.

**Q: Do you handle hosting and ongoing maintenance?**
A: Yes. We can deploy and host what we build, and our care plans ($300 to $1,500 per month) cover hosting, changes, and support for clients who want one number to call.

## 7. Objection handling

**Q: Why work with Uptimize instead of a big consulting firm?**
A: Speed, focus, and price. A big firm bills you for layers of project management. We do not. The person you meet on the first call is the person doing the work. We are built for owner-operated businesses, not procurement departments. And you can start with a $1,000 project instead of a six-figure contract.

**Q: Why work with Uptimize instead of a freelancer?**
A: We are not a single freelancer. The work is senior-led with deep IT, development, and architecture experience, and we run engagements with vetted specialists when projects need them. You get freelancer focus with enterprise discipline.

**Q: What if I am not technical?**
A: That is the norm. Most of our clients are operators, not engineers. Our job is to translate the technical decisions into business decisions so you can make them clearly.

**Q: What if I have an idea but no budget yet?**
A: Talk to us anyway. The first call is free. We will tell you honestly what is feasible at your budget and what is not. We would rather have a real conversation than a fake proposal.

**Q: What if the project fails?**
A: We work in phases with clear milestones so failure is caught early and cheaply. The $1,000 Starter exists exactly for this: prove the value on one process before committing the next dollar.

**Q: How do I know you will still be here in two years?**
A: In business since July 2022, a growing client base, and decades of experience in the IT industry. We are not going anywhere.
